input.answer: After 8 years, with 500 ₪ a month, it says I'd have about 68,853 ₪ in hand ("נשאר בידיים") on 48,000 ₪ put in. For 4 years it gives no number at all, just "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים", so I don't know what I'd get if I took it out early.

stuck.why: Bars for years 1–5 turned into empty dashed boxes with no explanation next to them, so I didn't know if something was broken
No number for my money, but there was still a big 25,725 sitting over an empty dashed box. I almost took that as my answer before I saw it was labelled 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך'

used: orange note about no calculation before 6 years
bar labels הפקדתם, החזר המס הוסיף, נשאר בידיים
skimmed: line 'קרן השתלמות במסלול מדד. 500 ₪ בחודש מכם, אחרי החזר המס'
line about 13,205 ₪ more a year also being exempt
skipped: text under the chart about 7% return, 2% inflation, today's prices
fields for income, return and fee: left at defaults

whether the 68,853 is in today's prices or future shekels
